query:
SELECT o.name, o.slug, COUNT(DISTINCT ova.ventureId) as venture_count
FROM organizations o
LEFT JOIN org_venture_access ova ON ova.organizationId = o.id
GROUP BY o.id, o.name, o.slug
ORDER BY venture_count DESC
